messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT #3421 resolved — embeddings timeouts. Start 2026-03-10T22:48Z, end 2026-03-10T23:06Z. Recommend after-action review. Link: https://incidents.redwood/3421

ingrid: We should schedule an after-action meeting to assign owners and track remediations. Who can host? Prefer window that works for PST and CET.

anya: I can host but OOO Tue morning PT. Can we do Wed 15:00 UTC? 1h should be enough.

sam: Wed 15:00 UTC works for me. I can facilitate if needed.

dave: Slight preference for 14:00 UTC to avoid late EMEA evening — either is fine. Also please add runbook owner to the agenda.

carla: I'll be the runbook owner. I can prep a short RCA draft and timeline. Recording ok?

oncall-bot: Oncall log: pagerduty -> oncall. First ack by @sam at 22:50 UTC; escalation 3 pages. Logs: https://pd.redwood/incident/3421/events

anya: Tentative agenda: 1) impact summary (5m) 2) timeline (10m) 3) root cause (10m) 4) mitigations + short-term fixes (10m) 5) action items + owners (25m). We'll record.

sam: I'll take notes and keep the action item list during the meeting.

ingrid: Can we pull in customer comms? @lina any chance you can join to sync external messaging?

lina: Yes I can join and prep suggested comms.

anya: I'll create the calendar invite and attach a short pre-read (timeline + key logs). Please add any must-have slides.

carla: Pre-read ack. Uploading the RCA draft and timeline to the incident doc now: https://docs.redwood/incident-3421

sam: :thumbsup:

dave: One more: include deploy hashes + model variant in pre-read. We need that for rollback discussion.

anya: Good call. @matt from devinfra — can you add deploy metadata and monitoring graphs?

matt: Yep, I'll add deploy hashes, model variant, and last-minute monitoring snapshots before EOD.

ingrid: Great. If no objections, I'll lock Wed 15:00 UTC and mark @sam as facilitator. Last call for other owners or agenda items.

carla: No objections. also adding a tiny log snippet to the doc for quick reference:

```
2026-03-10T22:49:02Z ERROR embeddings-service timeout seq=1024 ms=12000
2026-03-10T22:50:11Z WARN retrying request id=abc123
```

anya: Thanks. I'll send invite in 10m with pre-read link.

sam: I'll prepare the action-item tracker template and share before meeting.

ingrid: Perfect. Closing scheduling thread — calendar invite incoming. If anything urgent, ping here. :white_check_mark:
